item.title: How scientists are using Claude to accelerate research and discovery
item.description:
📝 These researchers have developed custom systems that use Claude in ways that go far beyond tasks like literature reviews or coding assistance. In many cases it’s eliminating bottlenecks, handling tasks that require deep knowledge and have previously been impossible to scale; in some it’s enabling entirely different research approaches than researchers have traditionally been able to take. In a third, Biomni analyzed gene activity data from over 336,000 individual cells taken from human embryonic tissue.
🔗 Read more: https://www.anthropic.com/news/accelerating-scientific-research

item.description:
📝 OCLC Seeks Permanent Injunction What we do know for certain is that Anna’s Archive’s troubles are not over yet. It is expected that OCLC will use the injunction to motivate third-party intermediaries to take action against Anna’s Archive. That said, it’s not unthinkable that OCLC will also send the injunction to domain registrars and registries, to add further pressure.
